A new begining!

Back to quest database

Drive Meriam to your ranch and complete the introductory handover.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Take the driver’s seat in Meriam’s car; being in the ranch area also satisfies this configured check.
  2. Wait for Meriam to board; the check also accepts reaching the ranch area.
  3. Drive to the ranch area.
  4. At the ranch, both you and Meriam must leave the quest car.
  5. Speak to Meriam. The inventory check requires a Bronze hammer, Red Tent and strawberry, at least one of each.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The final inventory check is a completion condition, not a verified reward list.
  • This introductory drive is configured for the farm owner.
Failure conditions, recovery & continuation
Failure trigger
Player death, Player imprisonment, Quest actor death, Quest vehicle destroyed, Game time reaches configured threshold 19
After failure
Starts a configured follow-up call; not a named quest
After success
Starts configured quest ID F_Quest_03

These route relations come from retained build fields; each branch is not runtime-tested.
